Author: Ramen (Meddle), fork for Soulweaver
Name: Meddle (Soulweaver)
Punchline: The exporter Soulweaver uses: a fork of Meddle. Install alongside Soulweaver.
Description: A fork of Meddle (https://github.com/PassiveModding/Meddle, AGPL-3.0) that Soulweaver uses to export characters, mounts and layout objects to Blender. Its source is in the same repository as this plugin. It can sit next to the official Meddle.
